subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write c. Start at the top and curl round like a cloud, but leave it open.

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says c, as in cloud.
This letter says c. Say the sound!
Trace c with your finger. Start at the top, curl round, stop before you close it.
Look carefully. Which one is c? It stays open.

hints: c is a curl that stays open.
Start at the top. Curl round, then stop.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write c for cloud.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Curl round and round, all the way closed. Look, I wrote c!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is o. c stays open on the side.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Curl round, then stop. That is c!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter c, say its sound and trace it.
